design_philosophy: Mission Control. High-density, extreme clarity, and industrial premium feel. Not an accounting software. Every pixel must serve an operational purpose. Dark mode native.

typography.instructions: Use IBM Plex Sans for all headings and body text. Use JetBrains Mono EXCLUSIVELY for numbers, data points, timestamps, and AI-generated outputs to enhance the 'Mainframe' aesthetic. BANNED FONTS: Inter, Space Grotesk, Roboto.

colors.instructions: Apply these exact hex codes in tailwind config. Do not use generic tailwind colors for status. The foundation must be pure/near black to reduce eye strain in a Mission Control setting. Never use pure white for large surfaces.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: The 'Technical' Look. Expose the skeleton. Use flat backgrounds with crisp 1px borders (`border-border`). Avoid heavy shadows. For premium elements (like Today's Focus), use a subtle `border-l-4` or glowing border effect with Premium Gold.
visual_enhancers.effects: No Glassmorphism. Mission control requires absolute clarity. Use solid colors. Subtle radial gradients behind key metrics (like Gold or Red glows at 5% opacity) can indicate priority.
visual_enhancers.animations: Minimalist. Avoid bounces or large scale transforms. Use smooth micro-interactions: slight background lightening on row hover (`hover:bg-surface_hover`), opacity fades (`transition-opacity`), and crisp slide-downs for expandable panels.

layouts.grid_strategy: MODE B: High Density Grid. Utilize CSS Grid for the main dashboard. A 12-column or 4-column base where cards snap tightly together with minimal gaps (`gap-4` or `gap-6`). Every pixel must be utilized. No jagged bottoms.
layouts.alignment: Strict left-alignment for text and data. Right-alignment for numbers in tables/lists. This creates a rigid, predictable reading line for fast triage.
layouts.spacing: Dense but readable. Use `p-4` or `p-6` inside cards. Ensure tight spacing between related elements (`gap-2`) and wider spacing between distinct sections (`gap-6`).

header.description: Sticky top header. Minimalist. Must include TFCS Mainframe title, Notifications bell, Catch Me Up AI trigger, Owner Access crown, and Quick Add.
header.styling: Solid background (`bg-background`) with a 1px bottom border (`border-b border-border`). Icons should use `lucide-react` with a default `text_secondary` color, highlighting on hover.
header.owner_access: Style the Crown icon using Premium Gold. You may use the provided CEO portrait alongside the crown.

todays_focus.description: The command center's highest priority module.
todays_focus.styling: Single horizontal card spanning full width. Premium styling: 1px Gold border or a glowing gold left border. Inside, present 3 items in a flex row or grid, clearly badged with TFCS Red (Action), Success Green (Success), or Gold (Ownership).

data_cards.styling: Cardless or 'flat card' look. `bg-surface border border-border`. Rows should be `flex items-center justify-between py-3 border-b border-border last:border-0`. Rows must be interactive (`cursor-pointer hover:bg-surface_hover`). Use JetBrains Mono for counts.

ai_catch_me_up.styling: Terminal aesthetic. `bg-black border border-border p-4`. Text must be JetBrains Mono, maybe slightly tinted green or gray, mimicking a console log.

recent_activity.styling: Vertical timeline layout. Use small indicator dots (Red, Green, Gold, Gray) connected by a 1px vertical line. Timestamps in JetBrains Mono.

owner_avatar.description: CEO portrait for Owner Access menu in the header.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets at least 4.5:1 ratio against the dark backgrounds. Muted colors should only be used for backgrounds, never for text.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Do not use standard Shadcn card styles (with rounded-xl and shadows). Customize them to have sharp or slightly rounded corners (max 4px) and 1px hard borders.
2. Inject IBM Plex Sans and JetBrains Mono via Google Fonts in index.css.
3. Set Tailwind dark mode natively and apply the brand colors directly in tailwind.config.js.
4. Implement the UI using simple `div` and `flex`/`grid` utilities to maintain the brutalist/industrial structure rather than relying heavily on pre-styled components.
5. Use `lucide-react` for all icons (Crown, Bell, Bot/Sparkles, Plus/Quick Add).
6. Build a fully responsive layout. On mobile, the Today's Focus card should stack vertically.
7. Include `data-testid` on all buttons and clickable rows.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Use strictly aligned, asymmetric, or grid-based structural layouts.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., `transition: all`). Always add transitions for specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. No `.App { text-align: center; }`.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable, but strip their default SaaS styling to match the Mission Control aesthetic.
Use `sonner` for any required toast notifications.
